reason: I have one apartment, Booking and Airbnb already send my messages, and the guests get my printed rules sheet. For what I earn, €150 plus €35 a month is money I do not need to spend on questions I already answer myself.
objection: Another monthly subscription for only a few months of bookings, and for one apartment next to my house where I can just knock on the door if a guest has a question.
would_change_my_mind: If it was free for the setup and maybe €10 a month only in July and August, and somebody showed me it really saves me phone calls in German and Polish.
